P086.title: A spectral element-based dynamic model for train-track-tunnel-soil interaction
P086.authors: L Pan, L Xu, B Yan, M Chen
P086.label: Pan等（2025）

complete_examples.text: To accurately described the complex geometry of the tunnel-soil system, this research employs iso-parameter hexahedral and triangular prism spectral elements to simulate the tunnel and surrounding soil, respectively, and describes the tunnel-soil interaction utilizing multiscale coupling method.

Iso-parametric triangular prism spectral elements for soil around the tunnel Since the tunnel shape is difficult to describe in the Cartesian coor dinate system, the iso-parametric triangular prismatic spectral elements, are used for modeling the surrounding soil of the tunnel.
